content.text: A trip by the British family – light, happy and full of memorable moments in the city of 1,000 flowers.

From the village of Hua Great City, Forest Square, Prince Long Ohayo, Lang Biang, Pollard Farm to Lang Biang Land – each destination is a personal experience, adding color to the Dalair's 3N2 NWA journey.
Thank the British family for trusting the TodayTourist choice.
Specially thank HDV Mr. Cheng for his cooperation, taking care of the crew throughout the journey.
TodayTourist – Travels All the Ways, Gives Full Trust.
